# awscc_ssm_default_host_management_configuration (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SSM::DefaultHostManagementConfiguration



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `customer_managed_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the customer-provided IAM role to register for DHMC. Required when PermissionModel is SELF_MANAGED and must not be set when PermissionModel is SERVICE_MANAGED.
- `last_modified_date` (String) The date the DHMC service setting was last modified.
- `last_modified_user` (String) The principal that last modified the DHMC service setting.
- `permission_model` (String) The permission model used to enable DHMC. SERVICE_MANAGED lets SSM create and manage the DHMC IAM role on your behalf. SELF_MANAGED registers an IAM role that you provide.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role currently configured for DHMC. For SERVICE_MANAGED this is the SSM-created role in the IAM reserved path; for SELF_MANAGED this echoes the registered CustomerManagedRoleArn.
- `setting_arn` (String) The ARN of the DHMC service setting.
- `setting_id` (String) The ID of the DHMC service setting. This is a fixed value that uniquely identifies the DHMC configuration for the account and Region.
- `status` (String) The status of the DHMC service setting. 'Default' indicates DHMC is not configured; 'Customized' indicates a role is configured.
